serious.en: This was not luxurious food. Hunger and starvation were actually serious risks for people across Britain, across Europe at the time.
serious.zh: 这不是奢侈的食物。在当时，饥饿和饥荒实际上是全英国、全欧洲人们面临的严重风险。

serious.en: To quote him exactly, "It was a serious strategic mistake to exit nuclear energy… we simply don’t have enough energy generation capacity ."
serious.zh: 原话是这样说的：“退出核能是一个严重的战略错误……我们根本没有足够的发电能力。”

security.en: So what changed? Well, first, there's the question of energy security .
security.zh: 那么，到底发生了什么变化？首先，是能源安全问题。

security.en: So you have the energy security question and the environmental one, but there's another factor: demand for electricity is booming , and this is largely coming from the technology sitting in your pocket.
security.zh: 所以，除了能源安全问题和环境问题之外，还有另一个因素：用电需求正在激增，而这主要来自装在你口袋里的这项技术。

seventy.en: And there's also the question that has haunted nuclear power for seventy years: nuclear waste .
seventy.zh: 此外，还有一个困扰了核电七十年的问题：核废料。

seventy.en: Fusion has been "twenty years away" for about seventy years, and 2026 hasn't quite broken that pattern.
seventy.zh: 核聚变处于“距离实现还有二十年”的状态已经大约七十年了，而2026年也并未完全打破这一规律。

separate.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
separate.zh: 美国的监管机构也已开始将核聚变视为与传统核电完全不同的独立类别，适用的法规更为宽松，因为聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生堆芯熔毁。

seriously.en: Potatoes originated in South America. But nobody seriously argues that fish and chips isn’t British.
seriously.zh: 土豆起源于南美洲。但没有人严肃地争辩说炸鱼薯条不是英国的。
